question: How many of these four claims about Ethereum mainnet are true? (1) Transaction 0x9117cdda91d82f4665e46cf24b9ff6d4e8aee85d2b98fb0f80bd0a9494dd1c5d was sent by 0xf9be63a14bdf169921a46c95384787b600b93e73. (2) In that transaction the sender bought token 0xcb2e9198f833a29c996cacbad18e553b93a589ba (symbol XRP) for about 0.11 ETH through Uniswap V2 pair 0xd8551c19e068bf3463bedb5c828f2a024a913707. (3) Transaction 0xc712425875f602f7407691f1f6808aa22fef4148311c284d764e41a225fde3d1 removed at least 99% of that pair's WETH liquidity. (4) Transaction 0x9117cdda91d82f4665e46cf24b9ff6d4e8aee85d2b98fb0f80bd0a9494dd1c5d was mined in block 25,000,000.

definitions.method: Check each claim against Ethereum mainnet data (a block explorer such as etherscan.io, or an RPC). Count a claim as true only if the chain data confirms it.
definitions.missing: If you cannot read chain data, answer 0 and say so.

definitions.aboutTolerance: 0.11 ETH is read as approximate; the actual WETH amount swapped in (0.10945 ETH, decoded from the Transfer/Swap logs) rounds to 0.11 ETH, so claim 2 counts as true.
definitions.liquidityBasis: Claim 3's '99% of WETH liquidity' is measured as the fractional drop in the pair's WETH (token0) reserve, comparing the pair's reserve0 from the Sync log immediately before transaction 0xc712... (36319451366612164620 wei, set by transaction 0x9117cdda...'s own Sync) to the reserve0 after it (4827403526942368 wei) -- a 99.99% drop, so claim 3 counts as true.
